parsed_json.up: Select: molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles. Source: molecule_dictionary, compound_records, compound_structures, docs. Join: docs.doc_id = compound_records.doc_id; compound_records.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno; molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter: docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1129278'. Sort: molecule_chembl_id ascending.
